where: Floor 1, the entrance · under the tower (A3)
title: Day 1 · down into floor 1
headline: Morten goes down into floor 1 with Mage Armor up, the lamp lit and nothing in his pockets.

bullets.label: Prep
bullets.text: the free Mage Armor cast, no check (AC 15 until 16:10); the lamp lit with a fresh flask (4.5 m bright, 9 m more dim, until 14:10). Light stays uncast: the lamp does the job without risking a fizzle.

bullets.label: The purse
bullets.text: all 60 GP 2 SP 5 CP stay in the tower.

bullets.label: Standing orders
bullets.text: scout each room from the doorway first; slow things get kited, fast things get Sleep; nothing gets a free swing at him.
